title: Japan Cultural Trails | Group Tour Package
highlights: Explore Japan's wonders as you journey from Tokyo's vibrant life and Kyoto's traditions to the beauty of Osaka and Hiroshima's history on this amazing vacation.
Walk past the Kaminarimon Gate and admire the stunning red lanterns and guardian statues as you visit Sensoji Temple, Tokyo’s oldest and most famous shrine.
Spend time in peace with a boat ride on Kawaguchi Lake, offering stunning views of the lush surroundings and Mt. Fuji, famous as the tallest peak in Japan.
Explore the sacred grounds of Todai-ji Temple in Nara and admire the beautiful idol of Buddha (Daibutsu), one of the largest bronze statues in the world.
Capture the bamboo grove from various angles, offering a unique experience as you visit Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, one of the most famous forests in Japan.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
Bring a portable charger for your devices, as power outlets may be scarce. Carry an adapter for Type A or Type B sockets.
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, traditional house or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
It's not customary to leave a tip for your server in Japan, as tipping isn't a standard practice in restaurants here.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time at Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo, Japan's capital city! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. After checking in, take some time to relax. In the evening, you'll be driven to Tokyo Station, where you'll board the metro to the lively Shinjuku District (fare included). Once there, explore at your own pace. Discover the bustling nightlife at Golden Gai and spend time in peace at Shinjuku Gyoen Park. Later, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin your morning by boarding the transfer from the hotel for Tokyo sightseeing tour. During this day trip, visit the famous Zojoji Temple, known for the stunning backdrop of Tokyo Tower. After that, witness various people moving on pathways in harmony at Shibuya Crossing. Continue towards Omotesando and admire the Imperial Palace and Nijubashi Bridge. Finally, explore Akihabara's vibrant streets and stroll along Nakamise Street. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kawaguchiko | Arakurayama Sengen Park & Shrine Visit | Kawaguchi Lake Boat Ride | Trip to Mt. Fuji-5th Station
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and board the transfer to Kawaguchiko. En-route, visit Arakurayama Sengen Park and Shrine, famous for its beautiful pagodas and views of the surroundings. Next, enjoy a relaxing boat trip on Kawaguchiko Lake, offering views of the famous Mt. Fuji. Lastly, visit Mt. Fuji's Fifth Station, where you can enjoy views of the Fuji Five Lakes. After that, you'll be transferred to Kawaguchiko and upon arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Visit to Arakurayama Sengen Park & Shrine

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | En-Route Iyashi no Sato Nenba, Shiraito Falls & Toyota Museum Visit
days.desc: After checking out from the hotel, you will be transferred to Kyoto. On the way, stop at Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a restored village turned museum that provides a glimpse into rural Japanese life. From there, continue to the beautiful Shiraito Falls, famed for its stunning, cascading waters. Afterwards, enjoy a visit to the Toyota Museum, which offers an insight into the global history of automobiles. Continue the journey to Kyoto and upon arrival, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time at Gion District
days.desc: In the morning, board the transfer from the hotel for the Kyoto sightseeing tour. During this day tour, enjoy a visit to Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, crossing the beautiful Togetsukyo Bridge. Next, visit Tenryuji Temple, one of Kyoto's five major Zen temples, followed by a visit to Kinkakuji Temple and the Imperial Palace. Continue the journey to the Gion district, famed for its Geisha culture, and enjoy some leisure time. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | En-route Visit to Todaiji Temple & Horyuji Temple | Leisure Time at Dotonbori
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and embark on a journey to Nara. Upon arriving, explore Todaiji Temple, home to a giant Buddha statue, and the ancient Horyuji Temple, one of Japan's oldest shrines. Continue your journey to Osaka and after reaching, check in at your hotel and relax till noon. Later, in the evening, head to the vibrant Dotonbori district to enjoy its lively nightlife and visit iconic attractions. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Okayama | En-route Visit to Hemiji Castle | Okayama Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After getting ready, check out from your hotel and set off for Himeji. Upon arrival, marvel at the grandeur and intricate architecture of Himeji Castle. Next, you'll be driven to Okayama to visit the beautiful Korakuen Garden, known for its serene lakes and waterfalls, and explore the impressive Kibitsu-Jinja with its remarkable long corridor. After a day of exploration, you'll be transferred to your hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | En-route Leisure time at Kurashiki | Hiroshima Walking Tour & Visit to Miyajima Island
days.desc: After you check out from the hotel, get driven to Kurashiki where you can spend leisure time exploring its city centre. Then, get driven to Hiroshima and enjoy the city walking tour, covering the Peace Memorial Park and Museum, and the Atomic Dome, highlighting 1945 atomic bomb incident. Then, you'll be driven to Hiroshima Port for a ferry ride to Miyajima Island. Explore its Itsukushima Shrine, famous for its torii gates and later get transferred to the hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Wrap up your journey in Japan with a bag full of memories and experiences and check out from the hotel. Head to the airport on your own to take the flight back home.
